# Pilot report fixtures (synthetic)

Every file here is made up for `test/pilot-report.test.js`. The names
(Zebedee Fakechild, Ms Fakename Testington, Fakey McFakeface) and the
example.test emails are fake and exist only to check that they never reach the
report. `ms-fakename-tiny/` is a class of 3, which the report must suppress.
